note: Sint Maarten keeps the Kingdom's Caribbean list; Guyanese and Jamaicans need a visa there. A visa for the French Saint Martin also admits its holder to Sint Maarten (not modelled).

sources.title: NetherlandsWorldwide (Government of the Netherlands), Do I need a visa for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom?
sources.said: Guyana: You do need a visa for St Maarten. ... Jamaica: Curaçao only. You do need a visa for the other Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. ... If you hold a visa for Saint Martin, you do not need a visa to enter St Maarten (the Dutch part of the island).
